RETORNO.FRASE_COM_MENSAGEM: Create a follow-up for {quem} {quando}: “{titulo}”, and send the customer: “{mensagem}”

OPCOES.RESPONSAVEL: Whoever handles it: on a card, its owner; in a conversation, its assignee

RETORNO.MANDAR: At follow-up time, send the customer a message
RETORNO.MANDAR_DICA: Only works when the automation runs on a card with a WhatsApp conversation. Outside the 24-hour window, the message only goes out with an approved template; without one, the team is alerted.
RETORNO.SO_LEMBRETE: Without the message, the team only gets the reminder.

QUANDO.FIM_DO_DIA: By the end of the day
QUANDO.DICA: Uses the account time zone. If today’s time has already passed, the follow-up is due right away, never tomorrow.
QUANDO.FRASE_HOJE: for today, by the end of the day
QUANDO.FRASE_AMANHA: for tomorrow, by the end of the day
